title: Circuit-breaker-orchestrated failover drill and snapshot-compare harness
creator: Ava Morrison
description: Objective: build and execute a repeatable active-passive failover drill that is driven by circuit-breaker events and validated by a snapshot-compare harness. The drill should: (1) trigger passive-region activation via an automated circuit-breaker trip; (2) run live traffic phasing with load-shedding policies enabled; (3) validate data consistency by comparing KV-snapshots and DB point-in-time backups between regions; (4) exercise rollback and graceful reattach procedures. This ticket covers runbook authoring, harness integration, two scheduled drills (canary + full), and post-mortem artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook exists and is scoped to <20 steps for operator execution
Automated circuit-breaker trigger reproduces intended degraded-mode routing (observed in traces)
Snapshot-compare harness identifies any KV divergences and reports normalized delta metrics
Load-shedding thresholds exercised without SLOs breaching >2% error budget for write path
Successful rollback (traffic return to primary) within target RTO of 15 minutes in canary run
Playbook reviewed and signed off by oncall, SE team lead, and PM
comments: 2026-03-10 - Ava Morrison: Ticket created after SRE guild review recommended a targeted drill that ties circuit-breaker behavior to passive-region promotion. Goal is to reduce uncertainty around KV divergence and rollback time.

2026-03-11 - Diego Alvarez: Drafted runbook skeleton (see Confluence link). Decided to implement a non-destructive snapshot-compare rather than live reads to avoid client-visible flakiness. Chosen compare window: last successful snapshot at T0 vs promoted region snapshot at T1.
2026-03-11 - Priya Shah (SE): Reviewed; recommended adding network partition simulation for 2m intervals and measuring retransmit/backoff effects on SLO latency tails.

2026-03-12 - Diego Alvarez: Canary run executed at 03:00 UTC. Circuit-breaker trip simulated by synthetic overload generator (loadgen-03). Passive region accepted traffic; KV snapshot-compare completed. Observations logged below in test_results. Opened infra PR to add a safeguard that gates promotion if KV divergence > 0.1%.

2026-03-12 - Oncall (Jamal Reed): Noted increased 95th percentile latency in read path during canary (350ms -> 520ms). We trimmed batch sizes and re-ran; latency recovered to 380ms. Filed follow-up ENG-513010 for adaptive-batching tuning.
2026-03-13 - Diego Alvarez: Full run planned for 2026-03-16. Security review requested; security notes added to Confluence. Preparing runbook checklist for run lead and secondary.
2026-03-13 - PM (Lina Park): Confirmed customer-facing SLOs and allowable error budget. Agreed to schedule a customer notice for the full run window.
test_results: 2026-03-12 canary - circuit-breaker trigger: SUCCESS (breaker tripped after 18s of RPS spike, traffic rerouted to passive-region per policy)
2026-03-12 canary - snapshot-compare: PASS (KV key-count parity 99.998%, 2 keys with timestamp skew resolved; normalized delta metric 0.002%)
2026-03-12 canary - SLO impact: read error-rate increased from 0.03% to 0.12% during steady-state 5m window, within tolerated canary threshold
2026-03-12 canary - rollback: completed in 12 minutes (within 15m RTO target). No lost writes detected; writes were drained and retried via client-ack path.
Known issue: transient 95p latency spike caused by batching heuristics under partially-filled batch; mitigation: temporary batch-size cap + follow-up tuning (ENG-513010)
retrospective_notes: Canary demonstrated the effectiveness of tieing circuit-breaker signals into automated routing decisions; however, the latency tail regression needs a runtime change rather than ops-only mitigations.
Snapshot-compare harness worked reliably and is fast enough to run during the canary window; add a synthetic golden-key set to accelerate divergence debug next time.
Operator checklist reduced time-to-restore by ~20% compared to the prior manual drill due to pre-baked CLI helpers.
Security sign-off pending due to snapshot storage lifecycle policy; GCS/S3 bucket policy review in progress.
